transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hello. Well, I suppose what made me come in is that my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I... I completely forget to eat lunch. And then other days, I just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets, even though nothing really tastes right to me.
Alongside these changes in your eating, how has your mood been feeling lately?
Well, my mood hasn't been very good. Most mornings, I... I wake up with this heavy, low feeling. It's just like the color has gone out of the day before I even get dressed. I just feel very down.
How long have you been feeling this low?
Well, let me think... I'd say this low, colorless stretch has been with me for about a year and two months now. It's just been a steady sort of heaviness for a while.

{"intent": "Screen for prior episodes of depression to distinguish single vs recurrent depressive disorder", "question": "Before this past year or so, had you ever experienced a similar period of feeling very low or
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had sad days like anyone else, but nothing that lasted this long or felt this heavy. This past year and a bit is the first time it's been like this.
Did a major life event, change, or significant stress happen around the time these feelings started?
Well, yes, actually. It all started about a year and five months ago... right around the time my sister's health took a very serious turn. That was when things really shifted for me.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities and hobbies that you used to enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to really look forward to my watercolor class, the quilting circle, and my book club. But lately... well, I'll get my things ready and then I just leave the bag by the door. I just can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go anymore.
How have your energy levels been lately?
My energy? Well, it's just been... very low. I feel tired a lot of the time, even if I haven't done much of anything. It's like my battery is just constantly running on empty.
How has your sleep been over this past year?

My sleep? Well, I haven't really noticed any big changes there. I'd say it's been pretty normal, for the most part. I go to bed and sleep through the night just fine... it's just that, like I was saying, even with a full night's rest, I still wake up feeling so drained during the day.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, or troubled by feelings of guilt or worthlessness?
No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel guilty about anything, or worthless... just very, very tired and uninterested in things. But no, I haven't been feeling down on myself like that.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, staying focused, or making decisions lately?

Well, yes, I suppose I have. I'll just sit there staring at really simple things... like trying to figure out whether to call the pharmacy or open the mail first. My mind just gets so foggy trying to think about it that I usually end up doing neither. It's just very hard to focus.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts that you would be better off not being here?

No, I don't have any kind of plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do find myself thinking sometimes that if I just didn't wake up one morning, it might be a relief. Mostly just a relief to everyone else, I suppose.
